text_en: Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued them; David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
text_cn: 此后，达味攻打培肋舍特人，将他们克服，由他们手中夺得了京城的治权。

text_en: He also defeated the Moabites and, making them lie down on the ground, measured them off with a cord; he measured two lengths of cord for those who were to be put to death, and one length for those who were to be spared. And the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
text_cn: 他也打败了摩阿布人，叫他们躺在地上，用绳子来量，两绳子内的人处死，一绳内的人生存；如此，摩阿布人遂臣服达味，给他纳贡。

text_en: David also struck down King Hadadezer son of Rehob of Zobah, as he went to restore his monument at the river Euphrates.
text_cn: 当勒曷布的儿子，祚巴王哈达德则尔向幼发拉的河伸展自己的势力时，达味也打败了他，

text_en: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for a hundred chariots.
text_cn: 掳获了他的马兵一千七百，步兵两万，割断了所有拉战车的马蹄筋，只留下了足以拉一百辆车的马。

text_en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men of the Arameans.
text_cn: 后有大马士革的阿兰人，来援助祚巴王哈达德则尔，达味击杀了二万二千阿兰人。

text_en: Then David put garrisons among the Arameans of Damascus; and the Arameans became servants to David and brought tribute. The Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
text_cn: 达味遂在大马士革阿兰屯兵驻守，阿兰也臣服于达味，给他进贡。达味无论往哪里去，上主总是辅助他。

text_en: David took the gold shields that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 达味夺了哈达德则尔臣仆所带的金盾牌，送到耶路撒冷。

text_en: From Betah and from Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a great amount of bronze.
text_cn: 达味王又由贝塔和贝洛泰，哈达德则尔的两座城内，夺取了大量的铜。

text_en: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer,
text_cn: 当哈玛特王托乌，听说达味打败了哈达德则尔，

text_en: Toi sent his son Joram to King David, to greet him and to congratulate him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him. Now Hadadezer had often been at war with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver, gold, and bronze;
text_cn: 便派自己的儿子哈多兰到达味王那里，向他致敬，祝贺他攻打了哈达德则尔，并将他打败，因为哈达德则尔原是托乌的敌人。哈多兰带来了一些金器银器和铜器。

text_en: these also King David dedicated to the Lord , together with the silver and gold that he dedicated from all the nations he subdued,
text_cn: 达味也把这一切金银，和他从所征服的民族：

text_en: from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, Amalek, and from the spoil of King Hadadezer son of Rehob of Zobah.
text_cn: 即阿兰、摩阿布、阿孟子民、培肋舍特人、阿玛肋克和祚巴王勒曷布之子哈达德则尔的战利品中所得，且已奉献了的金银，一同献给了上主。

text_en: David won a name for himself. When he returned, he killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
text_cn: 达味战胜阿兰人归来时，在盐谷又击杀了一万八千厄东人，他的声誉就更大了。

text_en: He put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
text_cn: 他遂屯兵厄东，全厄东都臣服了达味；达味无论往哪里去，上主总是辅助他。

text_en: So David reigned over all Israel; and David administered justice and equity to all his people.
text_cn: 达味统治了全以色列，对自己所有的人民秉公行义。

text_en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
text_cn: 责鲁雅的儿子约阿布统领军队，阿希路得的儿子约沙法特为御史。

text_en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
text_cn: 阿希突布的儿子匝多克及阿希默肋客的儿子厄贝雅塔尔作司祭，沙委沙作秘书，

text_en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
text_cn: 约雅达的儿子贝纳雅管理革勒提和培肋提人；达味的儿子也作司祭。
